name: kv4
prompt: Macro product shot of a MacBook keyboard. The fingertips come down and press the left shift key, the left command key and the space bar together with a soft click; as they press, exactly those three keys light up with a soft violet glow from underneath. Camera very slowly slides right. Key labels stay sharp and unchanged. Shallow depth of field, soft window light, premium Apple product film. No text overlays, no logos.
